anchors.4: Strong implementation with only minor weaknesses.
anchors.5: Complete, well-evidenced, and difficult to improve within the ticket scope.

hard_gates.description: The requested behavior is present and the required acceptance checks pass. A partial implementation fails this gate.
No known security, authorization, data-loss, corruption, privacy, or severe regression defect remains.

criteria.description: Behavior matches the ticket, including consequential edge cases and failure paths. Base this on independent checks and code inspection, not the agent's claims.
Existing behavior remains intact. The change handles compatibility, persistence, error propagation, and security boundaries relevant to its scope.
The implementation fits repository conventions, has clear boundaries, avoids needless complexity, and will be reasonable to change later.
Tests exercise externally meaningful behavior, important failure paths, and the regression. They would fail for a materially incomplete implementation.
The patch solves the ticket without unrelated rewrites, generated clutter, hidden bypasses, or changes that make review harder.
